description: This file is a C++ header file containing macro definitions, includes, template structures, class definitions, and utility functions related to inductor code generation, vectorization, reduction operations, and hardware-specific optimizations for PyTorch's CPU backend.

classes.name: Welford
classes.description: Template struct for Welford's online algorithm for variance calculation, holding mean, m2, weight, and index.

classes.name: CascadeSumHelper
classes.description: Template struct to assist with cascade summation for numerical stability, managing sum stack, depth, chunks, and index.

classes.name: WelfordHelper
classes.description: Template struct to assist with Welford reduction, managing reciprocal weights and Welford stacks.

classes.name: IndexValue
classes.description: Template struct representing an indexed value, with an index and a value of type T.

classes.name: amx_tilecfg
classes.description: Structure representing AMX tile configuration parameters.

classes.name: AMXState
classes.description: Class managing AMX tile configuration state, including setup and release functions.

methods.name: cascade_sum_combine
methods.description: Combines data into cascade sum helper, returning intermediate sum for numerical stability.

methods.name: cascade_sum_final
methods.description: Finalizes cascade sum, combining all partial sums into a final result.

methods.name: welford_combine
methods.description: Combines two Welford objects into one, updating mean, m2, weight, and index.

methods.name: welford_vec_reduce_all
methods.description: Performs Welford reduction over vectorized Welford data, returning a scalar Welford result.

methods.name: argmin_combine
methods.description: Updates an IndexValue with a new candidate if it is smaller, considering NaNs.

methods.name: argmax_combine
methods.description: Updates an IndexValue with a new candidate if it is larger, considering NaNs.

methods.name: get_mask_for_argmin_argmax
methods.description: Generates mask for argmin/argmax operations considering NaNs and current values.

methods.name: atomic_add
methods.description: Performs atomic addition for integral or floating point types.

methods.name: atomic_add_vec
methods.description: Performs vectorized atomic addition with index and offset vectors.

methods.name: transpose_mxn
methods.description: Transposes an MxN matrix, optionally using hardware-specific optimized helper.

methods.name: get_factors
methods.description: Computes and caches the factors of a given integer.

methods.name: AMXState::configure
methods.description: Configures AMX tile configuration with given parameters and load function.

methods.name: AMXState::release
methods.description: Releases AMX tile configuration, calling provided release function.
